    Getting started

    1. Patient and team (1-17). Age and gender fill in from the I/C number.
    2. Department and case. Pick one or more case cards: they are combined in the order you pick them. For teeth, set each tooth in the teeth builder, then press Write into report.
    3. Fill the blanks. Every ___ is a detail only you know. A note under each field shows where they are.
    4. Preview and save. The preview is the A4 form as it prints. Save the PDF, then print at actual size.

    Your data

    The app has no server and cannot send data over the internet. Your entries leave this device only when you save, print or share the PDF yourself. Follow your hospital's rules on where you send it.

    On a shared ward computer, don't choose “Keep everything”: the next person to open the app within 12 hours would see the last patient's details. You can change this in Settings.

    Your responsibility

    The templates are starting points written to help, not clinical guidance. Read every line before you print or sign: the clinician who signs the report is responsible for it.

    This is not an official Ministry of Health (KKM) product and is not endorsed by KKM or any hospital. Use it only where your hospital allows. The signed paper form is the medical record. The app is provided as is, without warranty.

    OT Report has a new address

    It now lives at ot-report.github.io, and updates come only from there. Your lists stay on this phone at the old address until you bring them across.

    1. Save your lists. One file with your staff lists, case cards, suggestions and Settings.
    2. Install the new app from ot-report.github.io. In it, open Lists & templates and press Import a file. A crest you uploaded needs uploading again.
    3. Remove this old copy. Clears what the old address kept on this phone. Then uninstall the old OT Report icon. Removed. You can uninstall the old icon now.

    Writing a case right now? Save its PDF first: a case in progress does not move.
